dogecoin.text:
Okay, so who among you actually listened to my wisdom on $Doge.

I knew this was coming. No #dogetothemoon tonight.  #DogeSNL 

I’m not saying it may not be a good long term hold, but these targeted big hype days always produce some level of bubble & burst.

It happens every time, I seriously need to start placing options on this. 

Every time there is a big announced $Doge event trend, a big pump, like #DogeSNL, instead those days are always when it falls. 🤣

Even if you don’t invest the movement around it is interesting to watch.
